plants.name: Aglaonema modestum
plants.tip: The toughest of the genus and the one that copes with a dim hallway. Let the top half of the pot dry first.
plants.colour: Plain mid-green, slightly glossy, on pale stems

plants.name: Aglaonema commutatum
plants.tip: Cold is what kills it, not neglect. Below 15C the leaves pit and blacken, and the marks do not grow out.
plants.colour: Mid-green with silver-grey feathering along the side veins

plants.name: Aglaonema costatum
plants.tip: Dwarf and slow. It sits happily in a small pot for years, so repot only once roots fill it.
plants.colour: Dark green with a white midrib and scattered white spots

plants.name: Aglaonema rotundum
plants.tip: Wants steady warmth and moist air. Dry rooms leave permanent brown pitting on the dark leaves.
plants.colour: Near-black leaves with bright pink veins and a red underside

plants.name: Aglaonema pictum 'Tricolor'
plants.tip: Humid air, no direct sun. The camouflage pattern flattens towards plain green in a dim spot.
plants.colour: Matt green patched with grey-green and cream, like camouflage

plants.name: Aglaonema nitidum 'Curtisii'
plants.tip: Tolerates dry rooms better than most of the genus. Wipe the broad leaves rather than misting them.
plants.colour: Deep green with narrow silver bands running out from the midrib

plants.name: Aglaonema 'White Rajah'
plants.tip: The pale midrib scorches in direct sun. Keep it a metre back from a south-facing window.
plants.colour: Green leaves split by a broad creamy-white midrib and centre

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Silver Queen'
plants.tip: Old stems go bare at the base. Cut one back hard each spring and it reshoots from the stump.
plants.colour: Silver-grey leaves edged and flecked with dark green

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Silver Bay'
plants.tip: Grows wide rather than tall, so give it floor space. Water when the top third of the pot has dried.
plants.colour: Large leaves with a wide silver centre and green margin

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Silver King'
plants.tip: Narrower leaved and slower than 'Silver Bay'. Overwatering shows first as yellowing lower leaves.
plants.colour: Slim silver-grey leaves with fine green veining

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Maria'
plants.tip: The one to pick for a dark corner. In low light it drinks far less, so check the pot before watering.
plants.colour: Dark green with soft grey-green feathering between the veins

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Maria Christina'
plants.tip: Copes with medium light, but the silver dulls in deep shade. Keep the compost barely moist, never wet.
plants.colour: Silvery-green leaves with a green midrib and darker edge

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Cutlass'
plants.tip: The narrow leaves lose water faster than the broad cultivars, so check it weekly in summer.
plants.colour: Long lance-shaped leaves, silver-grey with green margins

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Stripes'
plants.tip: Bright indirect light keeps the striping crisp. Direct sun bleaches it to a flat cream.
plants.colour: Green leaves ruled with fine silver-white stripes along the veins

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Emerald Star'
plants.tip: The speckling comes with maturity, so young leaves look plainer. Feed monthly through summer.
plants.colour: Mid-green with cream and pale green speckling

plants.name: Aglaonema 'First Diamond'
plants.tip: Compact and upright. Let it dry down between waterings, as the slim stems rot at the base quickly.
plants.colour: Narrow silver-white leaves with thin green edges

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Jubilee Petite'
plants.tip: A small desk plant in a small pot, so it dries out sooner than a full-size Aglaonema.
plants.colour: Compact green leaves with silver-grey centres

plants.name: Aglaonema 'BJ Freeman'
plants.tip: Gets large and top-heavy. Use a wide, weighted pot or it topples once the leaves fan out.
plants.colour: Big pale silver-green leaves with darker green mottling

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Pattaya Beauty'
plants.tip: Keep it above 16C. A cold draught from a door leaves grey blotches that never fade out.
plants.colour: Pale silver-green centres with a dark green margin, pink stems

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Super White'
plants.tip: Nearly white leaves carry little chlorophyll, so growth is slow. Give bright indirect light and do not overfeed.
plants.colour: Almost pure white leaves with green veining and edges

plants.name: Aglaonema 'White Lance'
plants.tip: The long narrow leaves crease if knocked, so site it clear of doorways. Let the top half dry out.
plants.colour: Very narrow silver-white leaves on upright green stems

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Osaka'
plants.tip: Dwarf and dense. Water less than you expect, as the small root ball stays wet a long time.
plants.colour: Dark green dwarf leaves flecked with white

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Key Lime'
plants.tip: The lime tone depends on light. In shade it dulls back to an ordinary mid-green.
plants.colour: Pale lime-green leaves with darker green margins

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Golden Fluorite'
plants.tip: Pale leaves scorch in direct sun. Bright indirect light keeps the gold without bleaching it.
plants.colour: Soft gold-green leaves with pink midribs and stems

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Green Papaya'
plants.tip: The pink midrib deepens in brighter light. Let the top few centimetres dry between waterings.
plants.colour: Yellow-green leaves with a bright pink midrib and stem

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Siam Aurora'
plants.tip: Also sold as Red Siam. The red edge fades in low light, so keep it bright but out of direct sun.
plants.colour: Green leaves with red midribs and broad red margins

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Red Valentine'
plants.tip: Needs more light than the green types to hold its colour, but still scorches in direct sun.
plants.colour: Green leaves heavily splashed with red and pink

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Red Anjamani'
plants.tip: Almost entirely red leaves, so it grows slowly by nature. Do not try to push it with extra feed.
plants.colour: Deep red leaves with a thin green edge and red stems

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Red Peacock'
plants.tip: Bright indirect light keeps the pink veining. Water once the top third of the pot is dry.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves with pink veins and a red midrib

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Lady Valentine'
plants.tip: The pink is strongest on new growth. Take off the faded old leaves at the base to keep it looking well.
plants.colour: Bright pink leaves with green margins and speckling

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Prestige'
plants.tip: Holds its colour better than most reds in average light. Let it dry down between waterings.
plants.colour: Pink and cream leaves marbled with green

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Anyamanee'
plants.tip: Wants warmth. Below 15C the growth stops and the leaves spot, so keep it off cold windowsills.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves flecked and washed with deep pink

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Chocolate'
plants.tip: The dark colour needs decent light to develop. In a dim spot new leaves open plain green.
plants.colour: Very dark brown-green leaves with a red midrib

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Pink Dalmatian'
plants.tip: The spotting varies from leaf to leaf and is not a fault. Bright indirect light gives the most of it.
plants.colour: Dark green leaves spattered with pink flecks

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Creta'
plants.tip: The red margin widens in brighter light and narrows to a thin line in shade.
plants.colour: Green leaves outlined in red, with red midribs and stems

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Wishes'
plants.tip: Keep it warm and out of draughts, and let the top of the pot dry before watering again.
plants.colour: Pink and red centres with green margins

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Sparkling Sarah'
plants.tip: Upright and compact. It sulks in a permanently wet pot, so water when the top third dries.
plants.colour: Green leaves with pink midribs and a light pink speckling

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Firecracker'
plants.tip: Narrow red leaves that dry out faster than the broad cultivars. Check it twice a week in summer.
plants.colour: Slim red leaves with green flecking and red stems

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Harlequin'
plants.tip: The colour mix shifts with light levels. Bright indirect light gives the widest range across a leaf.
plants.colour: Yellow-green leaves marked with pink midribs and green flecks

plants.name: Aglaonema 'Indo Rojo'
plants.tip: Strong red needs bright light. In shade the new leaves come through green and stay that way.
plants.colour: Deep red leaves with green centres and dark red edges
